newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GOLF-MALAYSIA TO HOST 1999 WORLD CUP.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-MALAYSIA TO HOST 1999 WORLD CUP.

text.p: Malaysia will host the 1999 World Cup of Golf one year after hosting the Commonwealth Games, the International Golf Association (IGA) said on Wednesday.
The 1999 World Cup will be staged at the Mines Resort and Golf Club near Kuala Lumpur, IGA chairman Jonathan Linen said.
Linen was speaking at Erinvale Golf Club near Cape Town on the eve of the 1996 World Cup which is being held in South Africa for the first time.
"We are delighted to come to Malaysia and be part of Malaysia's efforts to be prominent in the international sporting community," Linen said.
